primary_missing_sources.needed_source: Complete institutional master's thesis original file, plus any consented de-identified scoring metadata
primary_missing_sources.access_action: Use authorized university copy-request or lawful library access; do not invent text or bypass university authentication.
required_extractions: Seven exact original astrologers' questions, scale, coding, inter-rater reliability and treatment of discordant judgments
Exact birth year/month/day/HOUR, evidence quality and local/time-zone/leap conventions actually used
Per-domain n, coefficients, standard errors, confidence intervals, exact p-values and zero-result count
Pre-stated primary hypothesis and number of combinations/subgroups compared
All subgroup friendliness results and whether significance survives multiplicity adjustment
Missing cases, exclusion criteria, chart calculation software/interpretation school
Whether astrologers were truly blinded to subjects and outcome data

primary_missing_sources.needed_source: Complete 78-page university thesis with original Tables 4.1,4.2,4.10,4.11,5.1–5.11, equations and appendices
primary_missing_sources.access_action: Use legitimate university off-campus/public library SSO/ezproxy download; do not assume summary page gives full-text access.
required_extractions: Full quantitative sample N, inclusion/exclusion and source of birth date, time, place/time zone
Exact 14 main-star and four category mapping, paired/co-star status and original Zi Wei rule source
Definition of smoking outcomes and independently validated observation quality
Model covariates age/sex/cohort/education/socioeconomic/family or peer smoking, baseline and cluster dependence
Tables 5.1–5.9 full coefficients, SEs, p-values, CIs and star subgroup/selective reporting
All comparisons and multiple-testing controls, exact pre-data model lock if any
Out-of-sample tests or lack thereof, exploratory/confirmatory delineation
No confusion of cigarette warning-image DID results with astrological predictive validity

required_controls: Matched birth-chart decoys with nuisance date/age/season/cohort conditioning
Chart-label permutation null independent of test cohort answers
Single primary score and multiple comparison adjustment
Independent untouched human participant consent, privacy and sample size power plan
